Team —

Quick ask as we finalize the FYQ3 forecast: I pulled a small set of opportunities that are flagged as "stale" by our pipeline audit (attached). They either have a close date more than 90 days out with no activity or are in an ambiguous stage (Negotiation vs Commit). Please do the following by EOD Wednesday (2026-07-14):

- Confirm the definitive close date for each opp you own in the attached CSV.
- Apply the correct stage label: Negotiation, Legal Review, Commit, or Disqualified. If you select Legal Review, set the forecast category to Best Case.
- If the opportunity is no longer active, change stage to Disqualified and add a one-line reason in the comment column.

Two specific rows to note: ACME-3456 (Sara Patel) shows as "Negotiation" with last contact 2026-03-01 — please confirm whether we should move this to Commit or Disqualified. Marcus, there are two platform deals assigned to you that show placeholder close dates — please validate.

Attachment: stale-opps-FYQ3.csv (summary + owner column)

I will run a follow-up reconciliation on Thursday morning and push any remaining unresolved opps into a review state for the Revenue Ops team.

Thanks — drive clarity here will improve our forecast accuracy for the quarter.
